retained_initial_failures.cause: Python 3.11 labels the same 10.0.26200 Windows kernel as release 10; Python 3.13 labels it 11.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Allow only the Windows 10/11 marketing-name alias when numeric version, service-pack/edition, node and architecture all match. Preserve kernel and runtime bindings and add differing-host/build rejection tests.

retained_initial_failures.cause: Job active count reached zero before the process handle was signaled.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Wait on each retained child process handle before releasing ownership.

retained_initial_failures.cause: Two artifact collectors raced creation of shared output/jobs parents on Windows.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Precreate all owned artifact directories under the dispatcher lock; retain path containment checks.

retained_initial_failures.cause: ComfyUI logger replaced sys.stdout without retaining the stream wrapper; garbage collection closed its buffer.
retained_initial_failures.correction: Keep the original stream owners alive; native regression covers replacement and collection. Retain failed job records and all four seeds, confirm worker exit, explicitly retire the run, then calibrate with fresh seeds.

retained_initial_failures.cause: Host available commit 22614253568 bytes was below the 23702423143-byte policy requirement.
retained_initial_failures.result: No execution claim or submissions; competing workspace refused; owned workers stopped and device lease released.

limits: Native Windows tests cover actual process/job/lock behavior. HTTP fixtures cover submission races and lost acknowledgements without real model execution.
Actual pretrained calibration and any parallel trial are recorded separately; source/package tests do not establish GPU parallel qualification.
Same-user managed ownership does not exclude external clients, other users or legacy commands.
No hard capacity guarantee, simultaneous GPU kernel proof, speedup benchmark or media quality acceptance.
